comment: The required gates for a GoTavern release. scripts/verify-release-gates.mjs runs inside the publish job BEFORE gh release create and fails closed unless every workflow named here has a completed successful run whose head_sha is the commit the release tag points at. This file is hand-maintained on purpose (it is the release policy); the gate that consumes it is machine-enforced. GoTavern Release itself is NOT listed: a workflow cannot be its own precondition. The publishing run supplies its own build + prepublish qualification at the same tag commit, and the prepublish job executes the bare installers against the archives this very run built. A requiredEvent of workflow_dispatch means an automatically-triggered run (a push/PR run, which narrows its oracle probe set by changed paths) cannot satisfy the gate: the release evidence must come from a run a release manager deliberately dispatched with the full selection at the candidate SHA.

requiredGates.why: verify (gofmt, generated facts, compatibility matrix, classifier table, Go suite, vet, build, assets verify), race, browser evidence and the oracle sweep
one stock tree per subject, one browser lineage, restart on the same tree, and the 39-guard judgement
before/after/atDepth world-info slots reach the final provider request in pinned's order
the packaged archive boots against a stock SillyTavern tree on Linux and Windows
the pinned frontend's real journeys against a real browser, including the Q21 hand-back judge
fresh install, idempotence, update/rollback and cross-baseline data survival from the extracted archive
the paired performance record and the soak
the container image builds, verifies its tokenizer assets and smokes a pinned route
the pinned Tavern Helper's second-order state (scoped variables, in-use preset mutation, lifecycle events, iframe->bridge->disk->next-request closure) on both subjects with a 30-guard judge and teeth

one composed session (character x complex preset x 酒馆助手 x world info x variables x regex x Quick Reply x streaming x save/reload/swipe/regenerate/continue/group/restart) on both subjects, byte-equal per capture, with the five-leg matrix, restart, hand-back and the gate self-test; this is GOAL.md section 9 combination rule evidence and must be green at the release commit

exactly 20 real, popular, SFW third-party SillyTavern client extensions pinned by commit: each one installed, activated, setting persisted across a real server restart, disabled, re-enabled and uninstalled on stock SillyTavern and on GoTavern, judged by a taxonomy (PASS/FAIL/UPSTREAM_FAIL/N/A). The aggregator requires the observed set to equal the lock's 20 and requires the lock SHA-256, the head SHA and the capability verdicts, so a skipped shard or a dropped extension cannot pass
